target_customer: IT and security teams at companies that need device management with security and compliance enforcement beyond basic MDM
problem: Standard MDM tools manage devices but do not continuously enforce security and compliance, and often lack Linux support and visibility into shadow IT and AI tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS per device or per employee with a free tier for up to 5 employees
product_category: device management (MDM and UEM) with security and compliance

founders.name: Angelo (KC) Huang
founders.background_notes: From the YC company page. The page also lists a CTO named Mert and a sales head named Jeremy as team members, not as co-founders.

competitors.name: Kandji
competitors.what: Apple only zero touch device management with compliance rules for larger companies
competitors.traction_then: Reported growth during the pandemic as remote Apple fleets grew
competitors.funding_then: 21 million dollar Series A in October 2020 led by Greycroft, after about 7.4 million dollars earlier

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents and policy enforcement across macOS, Windows and Linux require deep OS knowledge and security hardening, but rely on existing platform MDM protocols.

defensibility.rationale: MDM deployments create some switching cost, but the market already had Jamf, Kandji, Intune and Mosyle as entrenched, well funded alternatives.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents kept dominating; no source shows the company being copied or acquired. The company later added AI agent governance to its positioning.

market_need_then: The pandemic pushed device fleets to remote work in 2020, and Kandji's October 2020 Series A coverage cites rising device management demand. The company's own pages stress SOC 2 and audit readiness as the compliance driver.

branding.domain_note: Uses the swif.ai domain; the date it was acquired was not found.

identity.logo: Green accent brand color #3AE87C per Brandfetch
identity.visual_style: Clean layout with checkmark icons and green accents
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold direct headlines such as Securely Manage Every Device and claims like Live in under 1 day

brand_strength.rationale: Sources show only the company's own marketing pages and a brand color listing; no press, community or merch about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Swif.ai is listed as an active Summer 2020 YC company that has moved from device compliance toward unified agent and endpoint management with AI agent governance. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff was found, and no verified funding round could be confirmed, so traction and the quality of its position against Jamf, Kandji and Intune remain unknown.
notes: Funding is unverified: CB Insights says 500 thousand dollars over 5 rounds with an August 2025 seed, Employbl says a 2 million dollar seed, StartupHub says about 4 million dollars, VCBacked lists Y Combinator, Team Ignite Ventures, Unpopular Ventures, an AWS and CrowdStrike accelerator and Addin Ventures, and Caplight lists NFX; all are aggregators with conflicting amounts, so no round is recorded. Founding year conflicts: the YC page and other listings give 2022 although the batch is Summer 2020, so founded_year is null. The Kandji source is dated about two months after the batch ended; Kandji is Apple only, so it overlaps only on the Mac side. Jamf and Mosyle existed earlier but no dated source was opened. A 2020 launch post and a Swif.ai specific outcome article were not found.
